title: Iridescent chrome on black

reference.grammar: black ground; one bent chrome slab shaded by a spectral gradient across its normals, thin yellow edge lines on every fillet; heavy film grain over everything; white condensed display headline; small words with split color channels

techniques.name: Spectral look-up table

params.order: navy 0 · blue 0.10 · cyan 0.22 · white 0.34 · yellow 0.44 · orange 0.54 · pink 0.64 · magenta 0.76 · blue 0.88 · navy 1

techniques.implementation: ART.lut(stops) gives 256 colors; the shading pass indexes it with the environment coordinate t, so color is a function of normal direction only.

techniques.name: Normal-buffer shading of a swept slab

params.section: rounded rectangle 300 × 160 u, fillet 30 u, 56 points
params.tilt_rad: 0.5 about the screen x axis through y = 740 u
params.wobble: n += 0.20–0.22·sin/cos fields of period 260–420 u plus 0.06–0.08 at 90–120 u, then normalise

techniques.implementation: Vertices P = C(s) + a·e1 + b·e2 with the section basis rotated by the twist; normals from the cross product of finite differences; triangles rasterized with edge functions into normal + depth buffers; per pixel the reflected ray of the orthographic view picks LUT[t].

techniques.name: Edge band and specular lobe
techniques.implementation: band = exp(−((|n.z|−0.34)/0.06)²) mixes the edge color in; spec = (n·h)^60 mixes white in; both read from the same normal buffer as the LUT.

techniques.name: Per-channel film grain

params.multiplicative: ART.grain amp 0.10, pitch 1 px, mono:false, seed 303
params.additive: σ 14/255 per channel on the ground, hashed per pixel, seed 304

techniques.implementation: ART.grain multiplies RGB by 1 + 0.10·n per channel (visible on the chrome and the type); a second pass adds signed noise of 14/255 so the black ground carries grain too, as film does.

techniques.name: RGB channel-split lettering
techniques.implementation: Each word is filled three times in #FF0000, #00FF00, #0000FF with globalCompositeOperation lighter on a transparent layer, offset per channel; where all three overlap the sum is white, at the edges one or two channels show; the layer is drawn under the chrome.

techniques.name: Condensed display headline

params.small: Archivo 700, 30 u, 2 columns × 3 rows at x 660 / 840, baselines 372 / 402 / 432

techniques.implementation: line 1 is sized to 924 u (font-stretch is set after ctx.font, which resets it); the figure sits on line 2 flush right; the slab is drawn after the type so it covers the bottom of the headline as the reference slab does.

pass_order: headline + small words · channel split on a transparent layer, source-over
slab · rasterize section sweep into normal + depth buffers
shade · LUT[t(reflect)] + edge band + specular, soften 0.7 px, source-over
grain · multiplicative per channel, then additive on the ground
notes: Measured on ref.png: ground (13,13,13) σ 14–16 per channel; headline white 243 σ 3; cap height 233 px = 142 u; line pitch 288 px = 175 u; small-word fringe 3–5 px at 1644 px.
Seeds 303 (grain), 304 (ground noise). Orthographic view, no perspective.
